description: Check an order: status (awaiting_payment → confirmed → printing → ready_for_dispatch → pickup_scheduled → shipped → out_for_delivery → delivered; or returning, returned, lost if the parcel did not arrive), tracking number once it is booked with the courier (ready_for_dispatch) with every courier scan in tracking.events, and — while unpaid — the payment_url again (so you can always re-answer "how do I pay"). Requires the order_token from create_order, or the API key that created the order (Authorization: Bearer mp_live_...).

order_id.description: The order_id returned by create_order, e.g. ord_01HZX8K3M9QWER5T7Y2B4N6C8D. Not the order_token.

order_token.description: The token returned once by create_order. Optional if you send the API key that created the order instead.

name: get_order
title: Order status and tracking
